_meta.purpose: Experimental Tm benchmark for validating the tool's SantaLucia 1998 NN Tm prediction (SPEC_phase5 PART C). Each oligo has a published or measured Tm under defined salt conditions.
honesty_rules: Only entries with verified==true are used in validation.
Tm values must be transcribed from the cited paper's tables or measured in-lab with the listed conditions.
Do NOT invent or estimate Tm values. Unverified entries are kept for tracking but excluded from MAE/bias calculation.
_meta.salt_conditions_note: Tm depends on [Na+], [Mg2+], [dNTP], primer concentration. Record the exact conditions from the paper. The tool uses: Na+ 50 mM equiv, Mg2+ 3 mM, dNTP 0.8 mM, [oligo] 200 nM.
sources: [SL98] SantaLucia J. Proc Natl Acad Sci USA 1998;95(4):1460-5. DOI 10.1073/pnas.95.4.1460 (PMID 9465037): NN thermodynamic parameters for DNA duplexes.
[SL04] SantaLucia J, Hicks D. Annu Rev Biophys Biomol Struct 2004;33:415-440. DOI 10.1146/annurev.biophys.32.110601.141800 (PMID 15139820): unified Tm prediction with salt correction.
[IDT] IDT OligoAnalyzer tool — empirical Tm data for validation oligos.
